section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedures for a Portuguese study examining emotional regulation and mental health. The initial sample consisted of 514 individuals (494 women, 20 men) recruited through online social network advertisements, with ages ranging from 17-57 years. Data cleaning procedures excluded male participants and those outside the 18-55 age range, though the final sample size after cleaning is not specified in this section.
